name: Moku
source: Moku likes to think she's the most popular girl in school and doesn't let stupid things like "the law" get in the way of a good time. She doesn't think too hard about things. Actually she doesn't think very much at all. Moku's life sits comfortably between dumpster fire and train wreck.
